title: Sea Chef Labs optional public entry setups
description: Public independently reviewed research only; review is never a buy or execution signal. Runtime validation in portfolio/entry-setups.mjs is authoritative for market identity, exact decimal comparisons, source URL restrictions, real dates, chronology, validity and freshness. No private funds, budget, ownership or account data.

venue.description: Trimmed plain venue name. Runtime rejects all Unicode control, format and surrogate characters.

pair.description: Exact asset then matching quote currency, optionally separated by one slash, hyphen or underscore. Runtime enforces the selected asset and currency.

positiveDecimal.description: Exact positive decimal string; no signs, exponents, whitespace or leading zeroes. Never rounded through a floating-point number for validation.

utcTimestamp.description: Real UTC date and time ending in Z with optional one to three fractional-second digits.

observationTime.description: Actual check/observation time, no more than five minutes after validation time. Future observations within that tolerance cannot yield review until their time arrives.

publicHttpsUrl.description: Public HTTPS DNS hostname only; runtime rejects IP/local hosts, credentials and credential query parameters. Syntax cannot establish official-source provenance or inspect redirects.

quote.description: The same exact venue, pair and currency as the setup. The source URL must appear exactly in source_urls. A refreshed quote may be newer than setup.checked_at; the root timestamp must cover both.

expires_at.description: Exclusive deadline strictly after checked_at, at most 24 hours later. Future deadlines are exempt from observation clock-skew limits.

source_security_checked.description: Researcher attestation that the official public source URLs and final destinations were checked. It is not a contract audit, an investment-safety rating, or a guarantee.

setup.description: Unique asset in the feed. Exact decimal ordering is 0 < stop < entry_min <= entry_max < target[0] < subsequent targets. Expired, pending, unchecked, stale and out-of-range setups remain Watch.
